packs.description: Agent goal and persona adherence: deterministic drift detection. Ships injection resistance (inbound override attempts and agent capitulation); role-relative drift requires semantic evaluation and is out of scope for static rules.
Agent-session governance: the autonomy, stop, compaction, evidence, and lifecycle safety-nets for autonomous AI agents.
AI governance policy: mode enforcement, scope, methodology, session, and transparency for licensed tenants.
AWS cloud guardrails: IAM, encryption, storage, secrets, and cost.
Business content and multi-country policy: tone, accuracy, formatting, legal, and privacy.
CI/CD delivery guardrails: build, release, deployment, and pipeline safety.
CI/CD security: pipeline, artifact, and logging safety.
Cluster networking guardrails: TLS, policies, and mesh/DNS.
Compliance frameworks: SOC2, NIST, and logging/audit mappings.
Container guardrails: image provenance, base-image, and runtime.
Cost-management guardrails: sizing, licensing, attribution, and cleanup.
Crossplane composition, provider-config, and lifecycle guardrails.
Data protection: PII handling, encryption at rest, and retention.
Documentation hygiene: ADR, changelog, API-doc, and general doc guards.
Engineering practices: twelve-factor, code-quality, API design, and code documentation discipline.
Git workflow safety: commit, branch, monorepo, and destructive-operation guards.
GitOps and ArgoCD delivery safety: declarative enforcement and sync-lifecycle guards.
Helm chart guardrails: dependency, values type-safety, versioning, and template safety.
Incident-management discipline: runbooks and postmortems.
Kubernetes platform guardrails: RBAC, pod-security, resource, namespace, and admission safety.
Go language guardrails: error handling, concurrency, style, build, and testing.
Java language safety guardrails.
Python language guardrails: type-safety, security, dependencies, and testing.
Rust language safety guardrails.
Shell scripting safety guardrails.
SQL safety guardrails.
TypeScript language guardrails: type-safety, security, dependencies, and React.

Observability guardrails: logging, metrics, alerting, and debugging discipline.

Secrets management: detection, container, architecture, and runtime handling.
Application security: injection, authentication, authorization, network-security, and cryptography.
Supply-chain security: dependency, audit, and package safety.
Testing discipline: test design, mocking, and reliability.
